title.zh-CN: 跨境医疗，从「想清楚」开始

lede.zh-CN: 不看病，不卖项目，只帮你想清楚。
lede.en: We don't treat. We don't sell. We help you think it through.

subtitle.zh-CN: 服务于全球用户与家庭，连接中国及海外优质医疗资源，覆盖来华就医与海外落地两个方向。
subtitle.en: Serving global users and families, connecting high-quality healthcare resources across China and overseas — covering both inbound and outbound healthcare journeys.

desc.zh-CN: 为海外用户提供来华就医的全流程支持，协助对接中国优质三甲医院及专科医疗资源，帮助患者更高效地获得适合自身需求的医疗服务。
desc.en: Comprehensive support for international patients seeking medical care in China, helping them access leading tertiary hospitals and specialist healthcare providers more efficiently.

zh-CN: 个性化健康评估与高端体检
专科预约与手术绿色通道
中医康复与术后康养支持
翻译协调与全流程跟进
en: Traditional Chinese Medicine rehabilitation & recovery support

desc.zh-CN: 为有海外医疗需求的用户提供本地化医疗导航支持，协助其更加顺利地进入海外医疗体系，获得合适的医疗资源与服务。
desc.en: Supporting individuals seeking healthcare overseas by helping them navigate local healthcare systems more effectively and access appropriate medical resources.

zh-CN: 初步健康咨询与案例评估
海外全科及专科资源对接
急症与复杂疾病转诊协助
医院预约及跨境沟通支持
en: Access to general & specialist healthcare providers overseas
Support for urgent or complex medical conditions

subtitle.zh-CN: 覆盖从预防到康养的全流程跨境健康服务，针对不同需求提供专业化的医疗路径规划。
subtitle.en: End-to-end cross-border healthcare across prevention, treatment, and wellness — with professional pathway planning for diverse needs.

subtitle.zh-CN: 从联系我们的那一刻起，专属医疗服务顾问全程陪伴与协调，以专业判断、透明沟通与患者需求为核心。
subtitle.en: From the moment you contact us, a dedicated consultant supports you throughout — centred on professional assessment, transparent communication, and patient-focused coordination.

title.zh-CN: 了解健康需求与就医计划

desc.zh-CN: 首先了解您的基本情况、目标与关注点，包括是否已有目标医院或医生，以及当前面临的实际问题与困惑。
desc.en: We begin by understanding your healthcare concerns, treatment objectives, and overall medical needs.

desc.zh-CN: 对您的需求进行初步分析与路径评估，帮助梳理优先级、识别潜在风险，判断是否适合进入相关医疗服务流程（非医疗诊断）。我们强调'先判断、再匹配'，避免不必要的流程与资源浪费。
desc.en: Our team carries out an initial review to clarify priorities, identify potential concerns, and assess suitable healthcare pathways. This process is non-diagnostic. We believe in 'assessment before referral'.

title.zh-CN: 医疗资源匹配与路径建议

desc.zh-CN: 结合实际情况，匹配适合的医疗机构、专科资源及服务路径。如当前方案并非最优，我们也会提供替代建议与专业说明。
desc.en: We identify appropriate healthcare providers, specialist services, and treatment pathways based on your needs. Where alternatives are better, we say so.

title.zh-CN: 制定跨境医疗服务路径

desc.zh-CN: 协助规划完整的医疗路径：医院与医生预约协调、跨境沟通支持、就医流程与时间安排、行程与落地衔接。
desc.en: We coordinate the wider healthcare journey: hospital appointments, specialist consultations, treatment scheduling, cross-border communication, and travel arrangements.

title.zh-CN: 进入正规医疗体系接受诊疗

desc.zh-CN: 所有正式诊疗均由中国三甲医院或国际认证医疗机构提供。医疗费用公开透明，由患者直接向医院支付。
desc.en: All clinical consultations and treatments are carried out by accredited institutions, including leading tertiary hospitals in China and internationally recognised providers. Medical fees are paid directly to the institution.

title.zh-CN: 诊后持续支持与健康管理

desc.zh-CN: 诊疗结束后持续提供：检查报告与医疗信息协助解读、康复与健康管理建议、后续复诊与持续沟通支持。
desc.en: After treatment, we continue supporting you with medical report interpretation, recovery guidance, follow-up care, and longer-term health management.

identity.zh-CN: 印尼患者 · 血栓术后康复

narrative.zh-CN: 一位来自东南亚的患者在接受血栓切除术后，仍存在肢体功能恢复缓慢及生活自理能力受限的问题。由于身体条件不适合长途跨境治疗，而当地优质中医康复资源相对有限，患者希望获得更加可持续、可执行的康复支持方案。我们以「先评估、再匹配」为核心，围绕本地化可行性、康复连续性与长期执行稳定性，为患者设计了基于本地合法执业中医专家的多阶段康复路径。
narrative.en: A patient from Southeast Asia, following thrombectomy treatment, continued to experience slow functional recovery and limitations in daily independence. With long-distance travel deemed unsuitable and limited high-quality TCM rehabilitation resources locally, the patient sought a more sustainable and practical support pathway. Centred on 'assessment before referral', we designed a multi-stage rehabilitation pathway with locally licensed TCM specialists — prioritising local feasibility, continuity of care, and long-term sustainability.

quote.zh-CN: 频繁跨境奔波并不是答案——稳定、本地化、可持续的康复支持，才是患者真正需要的。
quote.en: Frequent international travel wasn't the answer — stable, local, sustainable rehabilitation support was what the patient truly needed.

date.zh-CN: 第 1 阶段 · 联系与评估

event.zh-CN: 了解患者既往血栓切除治疗、当前身体状态及长期恢复目标，判断频繁跨境治疗并非最优方案。
event.en: Reviewed the patient's thrombectomy history, current condition, and long-term recovery goals; assessed that frequent cross-border treatment was not the optimal pathway.

date.zh-CN: 第 2 阶段 · 路径设计与对接

event.zh-CN: 围绕本地化可行性、康复连续性与长期执行稳定性进行路径设计，对接当地具备合法执业资质且具有海外临床服务经验的中医康复专家。
event.en: Designed a pathway centred on local feasibility, continuity of care, and long-term sustainability; matched the patient with locally licensed TCM rehabilitation specialists with international clinical experience.

date.zh-CN: 第 3 阶段 · 分阶段康复支持

event.zh-CN: 针灸、推拿及阶段性康复调理同步开展；建立阶段性恢复评估机制，根据反馈动态调整康复重点。
event.en: Acupuncture, therapeutic massage and phased rehabilitation initiated; ongoing recovery assessments established with adaptive focus based on feedback.

date.zh-CN: 第 4 阶段 · 长期持续跟进

event.zh-CN: 持续沟通与进度跟踪、长期居家康复建议，建立更加稳定的后续健康管理节奏，无需频繁跨境奔波。
event.en: Continued communication and progress tracking, long-term home rehabilitation guidance, and a sustainable ongoing health management routine — without requiring repeated international travel.

imageAlt.zh-CN: 印尼患者在康复诊所接受中医针灸治疗
imageAlt.en: Indonesian patient receiving TCM acupuncture treatment at rehabilitation clinic

identity.zh-CN: 澳大利亚华人商务人士 · 高端健康管理
identity.en: Australia-based business professional · Premium health management

narrative.zh-CN: 一位长期居住于澳大利亚的华人商务人士，由于长期跨境工作与频繁差旅，希望在短暂回国期间完成一次系统化健康评估与重点专项筛查。由于回国时间有限，且对国内医院特需体检流程、专科资源分布及后续健康管理衔接方式并不熟悉，客户希望整个医疗安排能够更加高效、有序。我们基于其商务行程紧凑、健康管理目标明确的特点，围绕「精准评估、高效衔接、长期连续性」进行了整体医疗路径规划。
narrative.en: An Australia-based Chinese business professional, with frequent international travel commitments, sought a systematic health assessment and targeted screening during a brief return visit to China. With limited time and unfamiliarity with VIP outpatient processes, specialist resource distribution and ongoing health management coordination, the client needed a more efficient and structured medical arrangement. Based on the client's tight business schedule and clear health management objectives, we designed a complete care pathway centred on 'precision assessment, efficient coordination, and long-term continuity'.

quote.zh-CN: 真正重要的，不只是完成一次体检，而是在有限时间里获得清晰、高效且可持续衔接的健康管理支持。
quote.en: What truly matters is not just completing a check-up, but receiving clear, efficient and sustainable health management support within limited time.

date.zh-CN: 第 1 阶段 · 需求沟通与健康评估

event.zh-CN: 回国前线上沟通了解健康关注重点、既往检查、家族病史与时间安排，结合年龄结构与生活方式进行初步健康风险梳理；提前规划体检方向与重点专项，避免重复检查与时间浪费。
event.en: Pre-arrival online consultation covering health priorities, prior assessments, family history and schedule; preliminary risk review aligned with the client's lifestyle and age profile, with examination focus pre-planned to avoid redundancy.

date.zh-CN: 第 2 阶段 · 体检路径设计与医疗协调

event.zh-CN: 对接国内三甲医院特需医疗资源，提前协调相关专科与检查安排；围绕客户时间窗口优化整体流程：特需体检绿色通道、专科评估方向、检查时间整合、陪诊与现场流程支持。
event.en: Coordinated VIP outpatient services at top-tier tertiary hospitals; pre-arranged specialist consultations and screenings, with the entire flow optimised around the client's time window — VIP fast-track, specialist direction, integrated test scheduling, and on-site escort support.

date.zh-CN: 第 3 阶段 · 高效体检与专项评估

event.zh-CN: 客户在半天内完成整套个性化体检与专项筛查，并就两项亚健康问题获得进一步干预与健康管理建议；过程中持续协助医疗沟通与流程协调。
event.en: The client completed the full personalised check-up and targeted screening within half a day, alongside follow-up intervention guidance for two sub-health concerns; medical communication and coordination remained continuously supported.

date.zh-CN: 第 4 阶段 · 跨境健康管理与持续支持
date.en: Stage 4 · Cross-border Health Management & Ongoing Support

event.zh-CN: 返澳后持续提供：中英双语体检报告整理、临床专家在线健康解读、后续健康管理建议沟通、中澳两地医疗资源衔接支持，依托双向医疗导航网络建立长期可持续的健康管理体系。
event.en: Post-return support included bilingual report preparation, online clinical interpretation, ongoing health management consultations, and continued China-Australia care coordination — built on our bilateral medical navigation network for long-term sustainability.

type.zh-CN: 外籍儿童来华重疾辅助
type.en: Inbound Cross-border Support for Paediatric Critical Care

identity.zh-CN: 外籍患儿家庭 · 亲体肝移植跨境支持
identity.en: Overseas family · Cross-border living-donor liver transplant support

narrative.zh-CN: 一位外籍家庭的孩子因病情需要接受亲体肝移植手术。家属在综合评估后决定来华接受治疗，但在正式进入医疗流程前面临大量复杂且时间敏感的跨境手续与协调问题——跨国文件认证、亲属关系证明、医疗审批及流程衔接等多个环节叠加，家庭需要在极短时间内完成大量准备，同时兼顾工作安排与孩子病情进展。在高压与高度不确定性的医疗环境中，家庭希望获得更加专业、清晰且持续性的跨境支持。
narrative.en: An overseas family's child required a living-donor liver transplant. After careful evaluation, the family chose to pursue treatment in China but faced a complex, time-critical cross-border process — international document certification, family-relationship verification, medical approvals, and care-pathway coordination all converging within a tight window. Under the pressure of a critical condition and significant uncertainty, the family sought professional, clear and continuous cross-border support.

quote.zh-CN: 在重大疾病面前，真正减轻压力的，不只是医疗资源本身，而是有人帮助我们把复杂流程变得清晰、有序且可执行。
quote.en: Facing a critical illness, what truly eases the burden is not just access to medical resources, but having someone make a complex process clear, structured, and actionable.

date.zh-CN: 第 1 阶段 · 紧急需求响应与初步评估

event.zh-CN: 第一时间了解患儿病情进展、计划治疗方向及主要困难；结合时间敏感性与跨境流程复杂度，协助家庭梳理整体治疗路径、关键时间节点、所需法律及医疗材料、各阶段流程优先级。
event.en: Immediate review of the child's condition, intended treatment direction and key challenges; given the time sensitivity and cross-border complexity, helped the family map out the overall pathway, critical milestones, required legal and medical documentation, and stage-by-stage priorities.

date.zh-CN: 第 2 阶段 · 跨境文件与流程协调

event.zh-CN: 协助家庭准备在华治疗相关手续：跨国公证与认证材料协调、亲属关系证明文件梳理、医疗流程资料准备支持、医院沟通与流程衔接协调。我们的角色不参与任何医疗决策，而是在合法合规框架下提供结构化流程支持与跨境协调。
event.en: Supported preparation of all in-China treatment formalities — international notarisation and certification, family-relationship documentation, medical documentation support, and hospital communication and coordination. Our role did not involve clinical decision-making but provided structured process support and cross-border coordination within a fully compliant framework.

date.zh-CN: 第 3 阶段 · 来华治疗与住院支持

event.zh-CN: 家庭抵达中国后，继续协助院内外流程衔接：医疗沟通协调、就诊与住院流程支持、跨语言信息协助、家属陪同阶段协调，帮助家庭在高度紧张的治疗阶段减少信息差与流程复杂度带来的额外压力。
event.en: After the family's arrival in China, continued to support the in-hospital and inter-facility pathway: medical communication, admission and inpatient logistics, cross-language information support, and family accompaniment coordination — reducing the additional burden of information gaps and procedural complexity during a highly stressful phase.

date.zh-CN: 第 4 阶段 · 术后恢复与持续跟进

event.zh-CN: 患儿顺利在国内三甲医院完成亲体肝移植手术，进入术后恢复阶段；后续继续协助阶段性沟通与支持，帮助家庭顺利衔接后续康复与长期随访安排。
event.en: The child successfully underwent living-donor liver transplantation at a top-tier tertiary hospital and entered the post-operative recovery phase; ongoing communication and stage-based coordination continued to support the family through rehabilitation and long-term follow-up arrangements.
